hypothesis: More agents produce higher quality without a baseline.
falsification_condition: A single worker or manager-worker matches quality at equal budget.

evidence: The run reports success rate only for the swarm condition; the single-worker cell is missing.
evaluators.strongest_objection: The result cannot support a coordination-advantage claim.
evaluators.strongest_simpler_explanation: A single competent worker would likely match this quality on the same DAG-shaped workload.
evaluators.target_challenge: The hypothesis treats agent count as a quality proxy.
evaluators.next_experiment: Re-run with an equal-budget single-worker and manager-worker baseline.
evaluators.what_would_reverse_conclusion: A pre-registered equal-budget baseline that the swarm beats on a named metric.

findings.evidence: Only the swarm cell was measured.

proposed_task.title: Add equal-budget single-worker baseline to the claimed run
proposed_task.hypothesis: The swarm advantage disappears under an equal-budget single worker.
proposed_task.falsification_condition: Swarm still wins after the baseline is run with the same models, tools, and token budget.

evidence: Workload is a write-then-finalize DAG; a deterministic workflow explains the same trace.
evaluators.strongest_objection: Apparent emergence is a hidden linear pipeline.
evaluators.strongest_simpler_explanation: A deterministic DAG/workflow with two stages produces the same artifacts.
evaluators.target_challenge: yes — swarm success on a DAG is the wrong benchmark
evaluators.next_experiment: Move the claim to a heterogeneous, failure-prone workload or drop it.

evidence: Token spend was not reported; wall time was 4x a single worker in the author notes.
evaluators.strongest_simpler_explanation: Run the single worker once and stop.
evaluators.next_experiment: Record tokens, wall time, and duplicate-work counts.

evidence: No worker-kill, lease expiry, or duplicate-claim trial was run.
evaluators.strongest_simpler_explanation: A manager that retries a failed worker explains recovery equally well.
evaluators.next_experiment: Kill the lead worker mid-run and compare recovery time to manager-worker.

evidence: Demo script hard-codes the happy path and names it emergent.
evaluators.strongest_objection: The word emergent is used without an ablation.
evaluators.strongest_simpler_explanation: Delete the swarm wrapper and keep the two-step script.
evaluators.next_experiment: Ablate the field/pheromone layer and show a metric change.
evaluators.invariant_named: Do not call a behavior emergent without a public baseline and an ablation.
evaluators.deletion_candidate: The swarm wrapper around the DAG.
